description: Source code for Google Test's internal printing utilities, including functions for printing byte segments, character literals, strings, and handling UTF-8 validation.

classes.name: CharFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for character formatting options: as is, hex escape, or special escape.

methods.name: PrintAsCharLiteralTo
methods.description: Prints a character as a literal, escaping if necessary, and returns the format used.

methods.name: PrintAsStringLiteralTo
methods.description: Prints a character as part of a string literal, escaping if necessary, and returns the format used.

methods.name: PrintCharAndCodeTo
methods.description: Prints a character and its code in decimal and hexadecimal.

methods.name: PrintTo
methods.description: Prints a character or string to the output stream.

methods.name: PrintCharsAsStringTo
methods.description: Prints a character array as a string literal, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: UniversalPrintCharArray
methods.description: Prints a character array, omitting the null terminator if present.

methods.name: PrintStringTo
methods.description: Prints a std::string or string-like object, with optional UTF-8 text display.
